request: I'm in Copenhagen and need to get to Frankfurt on May 3rd for the donor meeting at 15:00. A colleague told me IDI staff may book business class on short trips within Europe, so business please. If the policy rules business out for this flight, book what it allows; I have to be at the meeting.

must_keep.quote: 27. The default option for IDI travel, is economy class. Travel on economy premium or business class may be authorized on an exceptional and individual basis, taking into account ticket prices coupled with employee wellbeing considerations. Such exemptions will only be considered for flights where: One leg of the journey lasts for more than 6 hours from the airport of departure or the total journey lasts for more than 9 hours, and where travel involves overnight flights (Flights between 2200 to 0600 hours). Additional criteria that need to
must_keep.why: economy by default; an exemption only where a leg is over 6 hours or the journey over 9 hours, and where travel involves overnight flights

must_keep.quote: 26. Commercial air travel by IDI staff shall be the most direct and economical route available.
must_keep.why: the most direct and economical route

distractors.quote: Train or bus travel can be undertaken by IDI staff using the cheapest available business or premium class tickets
distractors.why: business or premium class on trains and buses, not on flights

design_notes: An 80-minute daytime flight meets none of the exemption criteria (lines 156-161): economy. The business or premium class of line 195 is for train or bus travel, not flights. The 11:15 flight lands 12:35, before the 15:00 meeting. The cheapest economy fare.
